response.why: I drew a second Floodpits Drowner, which gives me two ways to neutralize Enduring Curiosity, but neither should be spent at draw step — their lands are all tapped, so nothing can interfere in my main phase and I lose nothing by waiting. Main phase I want Kaito ({2}{U}{B}, exactly my four mana) plus -2 to tap and double-stun Curiosity: that empties their blockers for a 5-point attack and keeps the Drowner shuffle available later as a permanent answer.
response.plan: Pass to main: play the tapped Sewers, cast Kaito, -2 to tap Enduring Curiosity with two stun counters, then attack with Preacher, Deep-Cavern Bat and Floodpits Drowner for 5 into an empty board. Next turn, shuffle the stunned Curiosity away with Drowner's {1}{U},{T} (it dodges the 'returns when it dies' clause) and deploy the second Drowner. Keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

response.why: Play the land first — Undercity Sewers is free value (surveil 1) and costs me nothing since it enters tapped, leaving all four untapped lands for Kaito ({2}{U}{B}) right after. Their lands are all tapped, so Kaito resolves safely; his -2 taps Enduring Curiosity with two stun counters, emptying their blockers so Preacher, Bat and Drowner swing for 5, and Curiosity still can't untap for two turns while I keep the Drowner shuffle as a permanent answer.
response.plan: Play Undercity Sewers, then cast Kaito and -2 to tap-and-double-stun Enduring Curiosity, then attack with Preacher, Deep-Cavern Bat and Floodpits Drowner for 5 (17→12). Next turn with five lands: shuffle the stunned Curiosity away with Drowner's {1}{U},{T} and cast the second Drowner. Keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

response.why: Their board is one tapped, stunned Preacher and four tapped lands — they cannot block and cannot cast anything, so both my attackers get through for free: 3 damage (17→14) plus a life from the lifelink Bat and a card off Preacher's trigger while I'm ahead on life. The crack-back is nearly nil since their Preacher's stun counter means it stays tapped through their untap, and my untapped Floodpits Drowner stays home as a blocker.
response.plan: Attack with Preacher of the Schism and Deep-Cavern Bat (Drowner is summoning sick and stays back as a blocker). Next turn cast Kaito with five lands and keep pressing; keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

response.why: Upkeep with five untapped lands and no reason to act early — everything I want costs four and is better cast in my main phase, where I can also make my land drop first. I'm way ahead (21-14), their only untapped creature is one summoning-sick Preacher, and my deathtouch Preacher plus flying Bat can attack profitably into it.
response.plan: Pass to main: cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares (my strongest card — a hexproof 3/4 on my turns plus card advantage), then attack with Preacher of the Schism (deathtouch punishes their 2/4 blocking) and the flying Bat. Keep Enduring Curiosity and Faerie Mastermind as follow-ups; keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

response.why: Pass is correct here. It is my Draw step with 5 untapped lands and a hand of Preacher, Faerie Mastermind, Kaito, Enduring Curiosity, Swamp. Kaito is my strongest card and is sorcery-speed only, so I must keep 4 mana open into my main phase to cast him. Faerie Mastermind and Enduring Curiosity both have flash and are strictly better held as end-of-turn plays or ambush blockers, and casting either now spends the mana Kaito needs. Leaves where I simply do nothing (4, 9, 14) preserve full flexibility and score highest; the Enduring Curiosity leaves score lowest because it is a 4/3 that would sit summoning sick, telegraph itself, and cost me my whole turn's mana.
response.plan: Pass to main phase: play the Swamp, cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, then attack with Preacher of the Schism (deathtouch punishes their untapped 2/4 Preacher blocking) and the flying Deep-Cavern Bat. Keep Enduring Curiosity and Faerie Mastermind as flash follow-ups; keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

That dominates casting Kaito immediately (leaves 28-30), which locks me to 1 floating mana and gives up the land drop for this turn. Passing my main phase entirely (0-14) throws away both the land and Kaito, my best card. Casting Preacher (15-22) or Faerie Mastermind (23-27) at sorcery speed taps me out of Kaito and walks a flash creature into their open removal for no gain; Enduring Curiosity (31-33) is a 4/3 that sits summoning sick and eats a removal spell. Note their only untapped lands are Darkslick Shores and one Swamp - two mana - so every leaf where they cast Sheoldred, Anoint with Affliction, or Enduring Curiosity right now is impossible, and I score those on the board state rather than the fantasy spell.

response.why: The Swamp is down and all six lands are untapped, so now I cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares - the plan I set last decision. On my turn he is a hexproof 3/4 Ninja, which means their entire removal suite (Cut Down, Go for the Throat, Anoint with Affliction) cannot touch him while he attacks, and he leaves two mana up for the Drowner's shuffle activation. Passing (0-14) throws the turn away. Preacher (15-23) and Enduring Curiosity (47-55) both tap me below Kaito's cost and present targets their removal can actually kill. Faerie Mastermind at sorcery speed (24-38) is the worst use of the turn - a 2/1 that dies to everything, cast with no information. Note they have only two untapped lands (Darkslick Shores plus a Swamp), so every leaf where they resolve Sheoldred, Anoint with Affliction, or Enduring Curiosity this instant is impossible; I score those on the real board, not the imagined spell. Even the punishing Kaito leaves - they Go for the Throat my Preacher, or flash a Drowner and Cut Down mine - still leave Kaito on the battlefield and untouchable, which is why they stay ahead of everything else.
response.plan: Cast Kaito, Bane of Nightmares now with two mana left open. Then attack with Kaito (hexproof 3/4), Preacher of the Schism (deathtouch punishes their untapped 2/4 Preacher for blocking; I have the most life so I make a lifelink Vampire and draw), and the flying Deep-Cavern Bat. Hold Enduring Curiosity and Faerie Mastermind as flash follow-ups, and keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

response.why: Kaito has resolved and four lands are tapped, leaving {U}{U}/{U}{B}/{B}{B}. Faerie Mastermind has flash, so casting it now at sorcery speed is pure downside: it taps me out, walks a 2/1 into their open removal before combat, and gives up the option of ambushing or flashing it in at their end step where its 'opponent draws their second card' trigger actually earns something. Passing keeps two mana up and moves me to combat, which is the whole point of this turn - Kaito is a hexproof 3/4 on my turn and cannot be answered, Preacher's deathtouch makes their untapped 2/4 a terrible block, and I have the most life so Preacher gives me a lifelink Vampire and a card. Leaf 3, where they simply do nothing, is the clean version of that. Note they have only two untapped lands (Darkslick Shores and a Swamp), so the Sheoldred leaves are not actually castable right now and I score them on the real board. Even the worst pass leaf - they Go for the Throat my Preacher - still leaves Kaito and the Bat attacking with mana up, which beats every Mastermind line.
response.plan: Pass to combat and attack with Kaito, Bane of Nightmares (hexproof 3/4 during my turn), Preacher of the Schism (deathtouch punishes a block by their untapped 2/4; I have the most life so I make a lifelink Vampire and draw), and the flying Deep-Cavern Bat. Keep the two open mana for Faerie Mastermind at flash speed or the Drowner's shuffle activation, and keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

Holding the two mana keeps both real options live: flash Mastermind later, or spend {1}{U} and tap the Drowner to shuffle their stunned Preacher into their library. Keep the two mana open through combat: flash Faerie Mastermind at their end step, or, if they threaten to untap into something relevant, use the Drowner's {1}{U},{T} to shuffle the stunned Preacher into their library while its two stun counters last. Keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled.

response.why: End of combat with them at 9 and me at 21, holding four cards and {U}{B}. Pass and keep everything. Leaf 3 is the template for how Cut Down should get used: they flash in a Faerie Mastermind, it resolves, and I destroy it - a 2/1 totals 3, comfortably under Cut Down's 'total power and toughness 5 or less' limit. Casting Cut Down proactively right now (18-20) has no legal target at all, since both of their creatures are 2/4 Preachers totalling 6, so those leaves are the sim shooting my own board. Faerie Mastermind on my own end-of-combat step (15-17) is premature - it is a flash card, and leaf 15 shows exactly what happens when I commit it into four open mana: it eats removal for free. The Drowner shuffle (21-23) still spends my mana and a body for an effect whose target is frozen by two stun counters for two more untap steps, and it hands them a free window while I am tapped out. Holding everything (4, 9, 14) keeps Cut Down live, keeps the Drowner up as a blocker and as an instant-speed answer, and leaves them needing to solve a board they cannot block.
response.plan: Pass with all four cards and {U}{B} open. On their turn, spend Cut Down on a Spyglass Siren, Faerie Mastermind, Floodpits Drowner, or a Deep-Cavern Bat aimed at my hand - it cannot touch a 2/4 Preacher. Keep the Drowner untapped as a blocker and as the response to removal pointed at it, shuffling it plus their stunned Preacher away so their spell fizzles. Protect the Bat so their Kaito stays exiled. On my turn Kaito comes online as a hexproof 3/4 and attacks alongside Preacher, Bat, Drowner and the lifelink Vampire - from 9 life, that is lethal or close to it.

response.why: Both of their Preachers are attacking Kaito, not me - my life reads 21 in every leaf. That is 4 damage at a planeswalker sitting on 2 loyalty after the -2, so the only block that saves him is blocking BOTH; blocking one still lets 2 through, which is exactly lethal on a 2-loyalty walker, so leaves 1 and 2 lose a creature and Kaito. Blocking both saves Kaito but costs me the Floodpits Drowner and the Faerie Mastermind, because their Preachers have deathtouch - my 2/1s die and their 2/4s take 2 and shrug it off. That is two bodies for zero. I would rather keep the bodies. Kaito is worth less here than he looks: he is a creature only on my turn, and a 3/4 attacking into three 2/4 DEATHTOUCH blockers simply dies, so his combat mode is a liability. Meanwhile Faerie Mastermind flies and their entire board is ground-bound with no reach, so Mastermind plus the Deep-Cavern Bat is 3 unblockable damage a turn - the actual clock on a player at 9 while I sit at 21. Trading my only new evasive threat to preserve a 2-loyalty walker would trade away the way I win.
response.plan: Take no blocks and let Kaito go - he was at 2 loyalty and would die to either Preacher anyway, and his creature mode walks into deathtouch. Keep Floodpits Drowner and Faerie Mastermind: Mastermind and the Bat fly over their entirely ground-based board for 3 a turn, which closes a 9-life gap in three swings while my own deathtouch Preacher holds the ground. Hold Cut Down for a Floodpits Drowner, Spyglass Siren, or their Faerie Mastermind - it cannot legally target a 2/4 Preacher, and it must never hit my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. The Drowner's shuffle is still live on their stunned Preacher through my next turn; cash it in if I need to clear a blocker.

response.why: My upkeep with six untapped lands, and the single most important fact on the board: their hand is EMPTY. Every leaf here that has them casting Sheoldred, Spyglass Siren, Enduring Curiosity, a Bat or a Cut Down is fiction - they have zero cards and cannot act until they topdeck on their own turn. So there is no trick to play around and no reason to act before my draw step; passing costs nothing and I get to see one more card first. Note also that Cut Down finally has a legal target: their new Floodpits Drowner is a 2/1, total 3, inside the 'total power and toughness 5 or less' limit - but it is summoning sick and only a blocker, so that decision belongs in my main phase where I can sequence it against Enduring Curiosity and the shuffle. The {3}{U} 'each player draws' is the actively bad line and scores lowest: they are hellbent, so I would be handing a card to the one player who has none. My real turn is main-phase work - Curiosity plus the shuffle both fit under six mana - so nothing should be spent here.
response.plan: Pass to draw, then in my main phase cast Enduring Curiosity (4 mana) and keep {1}{U} to activate the Floodpits Drowner's shuffle on their still-stunned Preacher - this is the last turn that stun counter exists, and it permanently removes a blocker. Then attack with the fliers: Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind are unblockable by their entirely ground-bound board, taking them from 9 to 6, and with Curiosity out each connecting creature draws me a card. Keep my Preacher home while it is tapped, hold Cut Down for their Floodpits Drowner or any Spyglass Siren, and never point it at my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. They are empty-handed at 9 while I am at 21 with a full grip - grind evasive damage and do not give them cards.

response.why: I drew a Swamp, which is the key card for this turn: playing it takes me to seven mana and lets me sequence a full main phase. Their hand is EMPTY, so every leaf here showing them flashing a Faerie Mastermind, Enduring Curiosity, Kaito, a Bat or a Cut Down is fiction - they cannot cast anything until they topdeck on their own turn, and the Restless Reef animation lines are equally unavailable. With no possible interaction there is zero reason to act at instant speed in my draw step; passing to main costs nothing and keeps the land drop and full sequencing available. The {3}{U} 'each player draws a card' is the actively losing play and scores lowest across the board - they are hellbent, so I would be donating a card to the only player who has none, purely to dig one deeper myself while already holding the better position. Cut Down is also premature: its only legal target is their 2/1 Floodpits Drowner (their Preachers are 2/4, total 6, above its limit of 5), and that Drowner is a summoning-sick blocker I can answer after I have committed my threats.
response.plan: Pass to my main phase, play the Swamp for seven mana, then cast Enduring Curiosity (4) and spend {1}{U} on the Floodpits Drowner's shuffle to permanently remove their stunned Preacher - this is the last turn that stun counter exists - keeping {B} up for Cut Down on their Floodpits Drowner. Then attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind, which their entirely ground-bound board cannot block, dropping them from 9 to 6 and drawing me two cards off Curiosity. Never aim Cut Down at my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled, and never hand a hellbent opponent cards with the Mastermind activation.

response.why: Play the Swamp first - it is completely free, cannot be interacted with, and takes me from six to seven mana, which is exactly the difference between casting one spell and executing the whole turn. Their hand is EMPTY, so every leaf here where they Cut Down, flash a Drowner, or deploy Sheoldred is impossible; there is no trick to sequence around, only mana efficiency. At seven I can cast Enduring Curiosity (4), spend {1}{U} on the Floodpits Drowner's shuffle to permanently exile their still-stunned Preacher from the game, and still hold {B} for Cut Down on their 2/1 Floodpits Drowner - the only creature of theirs Cut Down can legally touch, since their Preachers are 2/4 totalling 6, over its limit of 5. Every other candidate spends mana before the land drop and gives up part of that line. The {3}{U} Mastermind activation is the worst thing on the board and scores lowest throughout: they are hellbent, so it hands a free card to the only player who has none.
response.plan: Play the Swamp for seven mana. Then cast Enduring Curiosity, activate the Drowner's {1}{U} shuffle on their stunned Preacher while that last counter still exists to strip a blocker permanently, and keep {B} up for Cut Down on their Floodpits Drowner. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind - their board is entirely ground-bound with no flying or reach, so 3 damage is unblockable, taking them from 9 to 6, and Curiosity draws me a card for each connecting creature. Never point Cut Down at my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled, and never activate the Mastermind draw while they are hellbent.

response.why: Swamp is down, seven mana available, and Enduring Curiosity is the right first spell. It costs 4 and leaves exactly {1}{U} plus {B} - the two things I still want this turn: the Floodpits Drowner's shuffle on their stunned Preacher (last turn that counter exists) and Cut Down for their 2/1 Drowner. Critically, Curiosity's trigger is 'whenever a creature YOU control deals combat damage to a player' - it does not need to attack itself, so even summoning sick it turns this turn's unblockable flier damage from Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind into two extra cards, and it leaves a 4/3 body home to block. Casting Preacher instead is a worse 3 mana: a fourth ground body that their three 2/4 deathtouch Preachers wall off, adding nothing to a clock that runs entirely through the air. Cut Down first is premature - its only legal target is their Floodpits Drowner (2/1, total 3; their Preachers are 2/4, total 6, above its limit), and that can wait until after I have committed. Their hand is empty, so every leaf showing them casting Sheoldred, Kaito, a Drowner or removal is impossible; I score those on the real board. The {3}{U} Mastermind draw remains the worst option on the table - donating a card to a hellbent opponent.
response.plan: Cast Enduring Curiosity now, keeping {1}{U}{B}. Then activate the Drowner's shuffle on their still-stunned Preacher to strip a blocker permanently while that last counter lasts, and hold {B} for Cut Down on their Floodpits Drowner. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind - their board has no flying or reach, so 3 damage is unblockable, taking them from 9 to 6, and Curiosity draws me a card for each connecting creature. Keep the Bat alive so their Kaito stays exiled, and never hand a hellbent opponent cards with the Mastermind activation.

Hold Cut Down for the first flier they topdeck; it cannot touch a 2/4 Preacher or Sheoldred, and it must never hit my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. They are hellbent at 9 against my 21 - keep the air clear and the clock running.

response.why: My upkeep, everything untapped, 7 lands, opponent hellbent at 6 with three 2/4 Preachers, a 2/1 Drowner and two 1/1 tokens. Note the leaves are simulating opponent responses off an empty hand — those casts are noise, but the shape of each candidate is still informative. Key card readings: Cut Down cannot target any 2/4 Preacher (total 6 > 5); my own Floodpits Drowner's ETB 'tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it' is real value — it removes a blocker for the turn and sets up its own shuffle ability later. Faerie Mastermind's '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card' is actively bad: it hands a hellbent opponent a card and taps me low, which is why every leaf under that candidate scores worst (40-52) — leaf 16/18/21/25/27 show opp_hand_count going 0->1, exactly what I must not do. Casting Cut Down blind in upkeep (leaves 15-28) wastes my only interaction on a 2/1 or a token that cannot block fliers, and leaf 20/21/23 even show my Faerie Mastermind dying to their removal afterward with no answer left. Casting Floodpits Drowner now (leaves 29-39) is the strongest line: leaf 29 is the cleanest position in the whole tree — their Preacher tapped by the ETB, my board five creatures wide, Cut Down still in hand, 5 mana open. Pure pass (leaves 0-14) is nearly as good but wastes the upkeep tempo. I score honestly: Drowner leaves that keep Cut Down (29, 34, 39) top the tree; leaves where I then also fire the Mastermind draw ability collapse.
response.plan: Deploy Floodpits Drowner in upkeep/main, using its ETB to tap and stun a potential blocker — that also arms its '{1}{U}, {T}: Shuffle this and target creature with a stun counter on it into their owners' libraries' as permanent removal on a later turn. Then play Darkslick Shores, cast Preacher of the Schism, and attack with Deep-Cavern Bat, Faerie Mastermind and Enduring Curiosity 4/3 — the two fliers are 3 unblockable and each hit draws a card off Curiosity, killing them from 6 in two swings. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw: it gives a hellbent opponent a card. Hold Cut Down and {B} for a Floodpits Drowner shuffle activation (kill the activator in response) or an evasive topdeck; never target a 2/4 Preacher (illegal) or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled.

response.why: My draw step, turn 15; I drew a second Preacher of the Schism. Full board untapped, 7 lands, hand of 5, opponent hellbent at 6. Opponent casts in these leaves are simulation noise off an empty hand — I weight by the shape of MY choice. Card readings that drive this: Floodpits Drowner's ETB 'tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it' is real removal-of-a-blocker plus arms its own '{1}{U}, {T}: Shuffle this and target creature with a stun counter on it into their owners' libraries' — every Drowner leaf shows their Preacher going to 'T' (tapped), one fewer blocker. Faerie Mastermind's '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card' is the trap: leaves 26/28/31/35/37/49-53 all show opp_hand_count 0->1, handing a hellbent opponent a card while taxing 4 mana; those score worst regardless of what else happens. Blind Cut Down (leaves 15-24) is also weak: its only legal targets are the 2/1 Drowner and 1/1 tokens (all Preachers are 2/4, total 6, above the 'total power and toughness 5 or less' limit), none of which block fliers, and leaves 19-23 show me losing Faerie Mastermind with no answer left in hand. Best leaves are Drowner-then-hold (29 at 88, 25/27/33/38 in the mid-80s): one blocker tapped, five creatures out, Cut Down and 5 mana still up. Pure pass (leaves 0-14) is a close second since I keep everything and can still deploy in main.
response.plan: Cast Floodpits Drowner, ETB tapping and stunning their untapped Preacher to strip a blocker and arm the shuffle ability for later permanent removal. Then play Darkslick Shores, cast a Preacher of the Schism, and attack with Deep-Cavern Bat, Faerie Mastermind and Enduring Curiosity 4/3 — 3 unblockable flying damage with a card drawn off Curiosity per connection kills them from 6 in two swings. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw: it gives a hellbent opponent a card. Hold Cut Down plus {B} for a Floodpits Drowner shuffle activation (kill the activator in response) or any evasive topdeck; never target a 2/4 Preacher (illegal) or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled.

response.why: The stun landed: all three of their Preachers are now tapped and CANNOT block, leaving only a 2/1 Floodpits Drowner and two 1/1 Vampire tokens as blockers — none with flying or reach. My two fliers are completely unblockable this turn for 3, and Enduring Curiosity 4/3 plus my ground Preacher can also attack into a board that can only chump. Best leaves are the clean holds: 4, 9 and 14 (86-88) keep all five creatures, 5 mana, Cut Down and both Preachers in hand for main phase. Casting Cut Down here is bad — every Preacher is 2/4 (total 6), illegal under 'total power and toughness 5 or less', so it can only kill a 2/1 or a 1/1 that already can't stop my clock; worse, leaves 15-19 show them responding by activating their Drowner's shuffle in response, and leaves 16/17 leave me at zero mana facing a 4/4 deathtouch Restless Reef. Faerie Mastermind's '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card' is the worst option in every branch: leaves 1, 3, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, 17, 20-28 all show opp_hand_count going 0->1, gifting a hellbent opponent a card and taxing me to 0-1 mana; several then show me losing a creature with no answer left. Leaves where their board shrinks (20-28) come from them shuffling away MY creature, not a gain for me.
response.plan: Pass to precombat main. Play Darkslick Shores, cast a Preacher of the Schism, and hold {B} plus Cut Down. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind — unblockable in the air for 3, drawing a card off Enduring Curiosity per connection — and consider adding Enduring Curiosity 4/3 since their only untapped blockers are a 2/1 and two 1/1s. They fall from 6 in two swings. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw: it hands a hellbent opponent a card. Use my Floodpits Drowner's '{1}{U}, {T}: Shuffle this and target creature with a stun counter on it into their owners' libraries' to permanently remove the stunned Preacher before its counter comes off. Hold Cut Down for their Drowner's shuffle activation (kill the activator in response) or an evasive topdeck; never target a 2/4 Preacher (illegal) or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled.

response.why: My precombat main with all three of their Preachers tapped and unable to block — only a 2/1 Drowner and two 1/1 tokens can block, none with flying. My two fliers are unblockable for 3 and Enduring Curiosity 4/3 can attack into chump-only defense. Best candidate is casting Preacher of the Schism: leaves 14-18 and 43-51 show a six-creature board with Cut Down still in hand, and note that in several the opponent's Drowner activation targets a stun-countered permanent, which is their card gone too. Leaf 17/18 (90) are the cleanest: extra 2/4 deathtouch body, 2 mana up, Cut Down and a second Preacher still in hand. Playing Darkslick Shores also scores well (leaves 32, 37, 42 at 86-88) since it keeps five mana and both Preachers, but it's the land drop I can make alongside the creature. Casting Cut Down blind is weak (leaves 19-27, 50-66 range low): all Preachers are 2/4, total 6, illegal under 'total power and toughness 5 or less', so it can only kill a 2/1 or 1/1 that already cannot block my fliers, and leaves 19/20/22/23/25/26 leave me at zero mana. Faerie Mastermind's '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card' remains the worst line everywhere — leaves 1, 5, 7, 10, 12, 19, 20, 22, 23, 25, 26, 29, 31, 34, 36, 39, 41, 52-58 all show opp_hand_count going 0->1, gifting a hellbent opponent a card while draining my mana.
response.plan: Play Darkslick Shores and cast Preacher of the Schism, keeping {B} and Cut Down up. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable in the air plus Enduring Curiosity 4/3 into a board that can only chump with a 2/1 or 1/1 — each connection draws a card off Curiosity and they fall from 6 in two swings at most. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw: it hands a hellbent opponent a card. Use my Floodpits Drowner's '{1}{U}, {T}: Shuffle this and target creature with a stun counter on it into their owners' libraries' to permanently remove the stunned Preacher before its counter comes off. Hold Cut Down for their Drowner's shuffle activation (kill the activator in response) or an evasive topdeck; never target a 2/4 Preacher (illegal) or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled.

response.why: Darkslick Shores is down (8 lands) and I still hold Cut Down plus a spare Preacher with {U}{U}/{U}{B}/{B}{B} open. All three of their Preachers are tapped and cannot block; only a 2/1 Floodpits Drowner and two summoning-sick 1/1 Vampire tokens can block, and none of them have flying or reach. Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind are therefore unblockable for 3, with Enduring Curiosity 4/3 and my untapped Preacher attacking into chump-only defense against an opponent at 6 with an empty hand. Leaf 6 (92) — pass, they do nothing — is the clean route to that combat with all resources intact. Leaves 2 and 5 (84) keep Cut Down and full mana even though they resolve an Enduring Curiosity; that 4/3 is a ground blocker that still cannot stop my fliers. Leaves 0/1/3/4 spend Cut Down on a 4/3 Enduring Curiosity — note its 'When this dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield' clause means killing it just brings it back as an enchantment, so that is poor value and leaves me at one mana. Casting Cut Down proactively (leaves 7-9) is worst: all Preachers are 2/4, total 6, illegal under 'total power and toughness 5 or less', so the only legal targets are bodies that cannot block a flier, and every branch shows them shuffle-activating in response; leaf 7 empties my hand entirely and leaf 9 costs me Enduring Curiosity to their removal.
response.plan: Pass to combat holding Cut Down and two mana. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind — 3 unblockable in the air since every Preacher is tapped and no blocker flies — plus Enduring Curiosity 4/3 and my untapped Preacher of the Schism into a board that can only chump with a 2/1 and two 1/1s; each connection draws a card off Curiosity. From 6 life they cannot survive this swing plus the next. Hold Cut Down for their Drowner's shuffle activation (kill the activator in response) or an evasive topdeck; do not spend it on an Enduring Curiosity, which returns itself. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw: it hands a hellbent opponent a card. Never target a 2/4 Preacher with Cut Down (illegal) or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled.

response.why: End of combat, opponent at 5 and hellbent with three tapped 2/4 Preachers and one untapped 2/1 Drowner — nothing with flying or reach, so my Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind deal 3 unblockable per turn and kill them in two swings while I sit at 18. The key discipline is holding Cut Down for the one card class that matters: a flier. Leaf 10 (88) is the standout — they flash a Spyglass Siren and I kill it on the stack before its ETB, keeping my clock fully unblockable; leaf 12 (82) is the same kill after resolution, worse only because the ETB has already happened. Against non-fliers I should NOT spend the card: leaf 4 (86) and leaf 9 (84) score highest in their samples precisely because I let a second Drowner or a Sheoldred 4/5 resolve and keep Cut Down plus full mana — Sheoldred totals 9 and is an illegal target anyway under 'total power and toughness 5 or less'. Casting my own Floodpits Drowner at instant speed (leaves 1, 3, 6, 8, 11, 13, 18-20) drops me to zero mana with Cut Down stranded; doing it in postcombat main is strictly better. Firing Cut Down blind (leaves 15-17) wastes it on a non-blocking 2/1 while they shuffle-activate in response.
response.plan: Pass through end of combat holding Cut Down and both mana. Fire Cut Down only at a flashed Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind — the only bodies that can block my fliers — killing it on the stack before its ETB resolves, or to fizzle a Floodpits Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. Let a second Drowner, an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or Sheoldred (illegal target) simply resolve. In postcombat main play a Swamp, cast Preacher of the Schism and the second Floodpits Drowner, using its ETB to tap and stun a blocker, keeping {B} up if the mana allows. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (illegal) or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Next turn the two fliers finish them from 5. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw.

Leaf 1 (58) spends Cut Down on their 2/1 Drowner — the only legal target, since every Preacher totals 6 — a ground creature that can never block a flier; it removes nothing from my clock and leaves me answerless. Leaf 2 (66) flashes in my second Drowner for an ETB stun, which is genuinely useful, but doing it now taps me to zero with Cut Down stranded; casting it in my own precombat main gets the same stun on a live blocker plus the land drop.
response.plan: Pass into my turn holding Cut Down and both mana. On my turn: play a Swamp, cast Preacher of the Schism and the second Floodpits Drowner, using the Drowner's ETB to tap and stun their untapped blocker, then attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable — from 5 they die to this swing plus the next, and Enduring Curiosity draws me a card on each connection. Keep Cut Down for a Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw.

response.why: My upkeep, everything untapped, 8 lands, hand of Cut Down + Preacher + Drowner + two Swamps. They are at 5, hellbent, with three tapped 2/4 Preachers, an untapped 2/1 Drowner and two 1/1 tokens — nothing with flying or reach, so Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind are unblockable for 3 and finish them from 5 in two swings. Best leaves are pure pass (0 and 6, 92) and pass-into-their-Sheoldred-doing-nothing (5, 86): I keep everything and can deploy in my own main with a land drop. Casting Floodpits Drowner now is the strongest proactive option (leaves 18, 22, 23, 27 at 84-88) because its ETB taps and stuns a blocker and I still hold Cut Down with 5-6 mana; leaf 22 shows exactly that with their Bat resolved but my answer intact. Casting Cut Down blind is poor (leaves 7-17, mostly 42-68): its only legal targets are the 2/1 Drowner or a 1/1 token — every Preacher is 2/4, total 6, illegal — and none of those block a flier. The Faerie Mastermind activation is the worst family throughout: every leaf that includes '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card' (8, 10, 13, 15, 19, 21, 25, 28-42) hands a hellbent opponent a fresh card and taxes 4 mana, and several show opp_hand_count going 0->1 immediately.
response.plan: Pass the upkeep with everything up. In my precombat main: play a Swamp, cast Preacher of the Schism, and cast the second Floodpits Drowner using its ETB to tap and stun their untapped blocker, keeping {B} for Cut Down. Then attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable — from 5 they die to this swing plus the next — with Enduring Curiosity drawing a card per connection. Hold Cut Down for a Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} draw.

response.why: Board is authoritative: I'm at 14, they're at 5 with an empty hand. Their three Preachers are TAPPED and cannot block; only an untapped Floodpits Drowner 2/1 and two summoning-sick 1/1 tokens remain, none with flying or reach. Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 flier plus Faerie Mastermind 2/1 flier are unblockable for 3 a turn, so they die to this swing plus the next. This is my Draw step, so passing costs nothing and keeps all 8 lands untapped and a 6-card hand for my own precombat main — highest scores. Casting the second Floodpits Drowner is nearly as good since its ETB taps and stuns their one untapped blocker and I still hold {B} for Cut Down, but there's no reason to do it a step early. Enduring Curiosity is a fine flash body but taps 4 mana for no combat relevance this turn. Blind Cut Down is close to a waste: every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, so my only legal targets are a 2/1 Drowner or a 1/1 token, neither of which can block a flier. Every {3}{U} draw leaf shows opp_hand_count going 0 -> 1, handing a hellbent opponent a card while I'm the one with lethal on board — lowest scores, always.
response.plan: Pass the draw step with everything up. In my precombat main: play a Swamp, cast Preacher of the Schism, and cast the second Floodpits Drowner using its ETB to tap and stun their untapped Drowner, keeping {B} up for Cut Down. Then attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable — from 5 they die to this swing plus the next — with Enduring Curiosity drawing a card per connection. Hold Cut Down for a flashed Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB resolves) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: Board is authoritative: I'm at 14, they're at 5, hellbent. Their three Preachers are TAPPED and cannot block; only an untapped Floodpits Drowner 2/1 and two summoning-sick 1/1 tokens can block, and none of them has flying or reach. Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 flier plus Faerie Mastermind 2/1 flier are unblockable for 3, so they die to this swing plus the next. The two 'Play Swamp' candidates and 'Cast Floodpits Drowner' score highest because they advance the plan for free: the land is pure upside (9 lands, nothing tapped, Cut Down still up) and the second Drowner's ETB taps and stuns their only real blocker while leaving {B} for Cut Down. Casting Preacher is fine but purely defensive here and does nothing to the clock. Blind Cut Down is close to a waste: every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, so my only legal targets are a 2/1 Drowner or a 1/1 token, neither of which can block a flier — and leaves 15-29 confirm it, dumping the card while their board is unchanged. Enduring Curiosity is a redundant 4/3 that taps 4 mana. Every {3}{U} leaf is worst: it hands a hellbent opponent a card and several leaves show my existing Enduring Curiosity dying to their Go for the Throat off the gifted draw. Land first, then Drowner, then Preacher.
response.plan: Play a Swamp first (free, keeps all mana up). Then cast the second Floodpits Drowner, using its ETB to tap and stun their untapped Floodpits Drowner — their only non-summoning-sick blocker — and cast Preacher of the Schism with the remaining mana while keeping {B} up for Cut Down. Then attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable; from 5 they die to this swing plus the next, with Enduring Curiosity drawing a card per connection. Hold Cut Down for a flashed Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB resolves) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 and Faerie Mastermind 2/1 are unblockable for 3; from 5 they die to this swing plus the next. Nothing left in my hand improves that clock, so passing to combat with Cut Down and 6 mana up is clearly best (leaves 0 and 6 at 92, the do-nothing branches at 90). A second Enduring Curiosity is a redundant 4/3 that taps me to 2 mana and strands Cut Down. Every {3}{U} leaf hands a hellbent opponent a card (opp_hand_count 0 -> 1) while I'm the one with lethal on board; leaf 33 is worst of all — it shuffles away my own Enduring Curiosity and Floodpits Drowner and leaves me with zero mana. Attack now.

response.why: Board is authoritative: I'm at 14, they're at 5 and hellbent. My second Floodpits Drowner resolved and its ETB tapped and stunned their Floodpits Drowner, so all three of their Preachers are TAPPED and their Drowner is tapped — the only creatures that can block are two summoning-sick Vampire Tokens, 1/1 ground bodies with no flying or reach. Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 and Faerie Mastermind 2/1 are unblockable for 3, taking them from 5 to 2, and the next swing kills them. Nothing in my hand improves that, so passing to combat with Cut Down and 6 mana up is best (leaf 10 at 92, the do-nothing branches at 90). Casting Cut Down now is wasted: every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, leaving only a 2/1 or a 1/1 token that already cannot block a flier — and leaf 24 shows the disaster case where I shuffle away my own Enduring Curiosity. A second Enduring Curiosity taps me to 2 mana for a redundant 4/3 that can't attack this turn. Every {3}{U} leaf hands a hellbent opponent a card while I hold lethal-in-two on board, and leaf 38 shows that gifted card being a Go for the Throat that kills my Enduring Curiosity. Attack now.
response.plan: Pass priority and move to combat. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable — all three of their Preachers are tapped, their Drowner is tapped and stunned, and only two ground 1/1 tokens remain — putting them from 5 to 2, with Enduring Curiosity drawing a card per connection; the next swing kills them. Keep Cut Down and the remaining mana up through their turn, with the option to hard-cast Preacher of the Schism or flash in Enduring Curiosity as a blocker. Hold Cut Down for a flashed Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB resolves) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. response.why: Board is authoritative and the alpha strike is already set up: their three Preachers are TAPPED, their Floodpits Drowner is TAPPED and stunned by my Drowner's ETB, and the only creatures that can block are two summoning-sick Vampire Tokens — 1/1 ground bodies with no flying or reach. Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 and Faerie Mastermind 2/1 are unblockable for 3, taking them from 5 to 2, and the next swing kills them. The one thing left that is strictly free is playing my land: it costs nothing, taps nothing, and leaves Cut Down plus 7 mana up, so both 'Play Swamp' candidates score highest (the do-nothing branches at 88). Plain pass is nearly as good at 90 but leaves a land in hand for no reason. Casting Cut Down blind is wasted — every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, leaving only a tapped 2/1 or a 1/1 token that already cannot block a flier; leaf 12 even shows me shuffling away my own Enduring Curiosity. Hard-casting Preacher taps me to 3 and adds a body that cannot attack this turn. A second Enduring Curiosity is redundant and strands Cut Down. The Drowner shuffle activation (48-58) throws away my own board for no gain and several leaves cost me a Floodpits Drowner outright. Every {3}{U} leaf gifts a hellbent opponent a card while I hold lethal-in-two, and leaf 47 shows that card being the Go for the Throat that kills my Enduring Curiosity — lowest of all.
response.plan: Play a Swamp (free, taps nothing), then pass priority and move to combat. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable — all three of their Preachers are tapped, their Drowner is tapped and stunned, and only two ground 1/1 tokens remain — putting them from 5 to 2, with Enduring Curiosity drawing a card per connection; the next swing kills them. Keep Cut Down and 7 mana up through their turn, with the option to hard-cast Preacher of the Schism or flash in Enduring Curiosity as a blocker. Hold Cut Down for a flashed Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB resolves) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability while it costs me my board. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: Begin Combat with the alpha strike already set: all three of their Preachers are TAPPED, their Floodpits Drowner is TAPPED and stunned by my Drowner's ETB, and only two summoning-sick Vampire Tokens can block — 1/1 ground bodies with no flying or reach. Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 and Faerie Mastermind 2/1 are unblockable for 3, taking them from 5 to 2, and the next swing kills them. Passing straight into declare-attackers with Cut Down and 6 mana up is best; the do-nothing branches (4, 9, 14) score 90. Casting Cut Down blind is wasted — every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, so the only legal targets are a tapped 2/1 or a 1/1 token that already cannot block a flier. A second Enduring Curiosity taps four mana for a body that cannot attack this turn and strands Cut Down. The Drowner shuffle activation is actively bad: leaves 41-55 show it removing MY own Floodpits Drowner and in several cases my Enduring Curiosity as well, for at most one of their tokens. Every {3}{U} leaf gifts a hellbent opponent a card — leaf 34 has them Sheoldred off it, leaf 36 combines the gift with shuffling away my own board. Attack now.
response.plan: Pass priority into declare attackers. Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind for 3 unblockable — all three of their Preachers are tapped, their Drowner is tapped and stunned, and only two ground 1/1 tokens remain — putting them from 5 to 2, with Enduring Curiosity drawing a card per connection; the next swing kills them. Keep Cut Down and 6 mana up through their turn, with the option to hard-cast Preacher of the Schism or flash in Enduring Curiosity as a blocker. Hold Cut Down for a flashed Spyglass Siren, Deep-Cavern Bat or Faerie Mastermind (kill it on the stack before its ETB resolves) or to fizzle a Drowner shuffle activation by killing the activator. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability — it eats my own creatures. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: This is lethal. All three of their Preachers are TAPPED, their Floodpits Drowner is TAPPED and stunned, and the only possible blockers are two summoning-sick Vampire Tokens — 1/1 ground bodies with no flying or reach. They are at 5. Attacking with everything sends Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 flying, Faerie Mastermind 2/1 flying, Enduring Curiosity 4/3, two Preachers 2/4 and the untapped Floodpits Drowner 2/1 — 13 power at a player who can chump at most two ground attackers with 1/1s. Every attack-all leaf is a kill: unblocked is -8, and even the worst two-chump case is -3. So all three attack-all leaves score 100. The Bat also has lifelink, and my Preacher's attack trigger draws me a card since I have the most life — irrelevant once they're dead, but free. Every 'hold' candidate has a worst leaf where both tokens chump and they survive at 1 or 2 life (leaves 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19), handing them an untap step with 7 mana and any topdeck — a real, unnecessary risk when the kill is available now; those leaves score ~72-74, while the lethal branches inside those candidates still score 100. attack-none scores 20: it leaves them at 5 with a full untap for no benefit whatsoever. There is no reason to hold a blocker back when the attack itself ends the game.
response.plan: Attack with everything — attack-all. Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind are unblockable fliers, Enduring Curiosity 4/3, both Preachers 2/4 and the untapped Floodpits Drowner add the rest; against a player at 5 with only two 1/1 ground chump blockers available, every block assignment still leaves lethal damage. Cut Down and 6 mana stay up regardless as insurance against a flash blocker: if they flash in a creature to block, kill it on the stack or after it enters if it is a legal target (total power and toughness 5 or less). Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability, and NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: Attackers are already declared — Deep-Cavern Bat, Faerie Mastermind, Enduring Curiosity and both Preachers are tapped and attacking into a player at 5 whose only untapped creatures are two summoning-sick 1/1 Vampire Tokens with no flying or reach. The damage is lethal on any block assignment, so the correct play is to pass and let it resolve while keeping Cut Down and 6 mana up as insurance: if they flash in a blocker, I kill it on the stack or on resolution provided it's a legal target. The do-nothing branches (0, 5, 10) score highest at ~90, and leaf 8 scores 82 because there Cut Down actually kills a flashed Faerie Mastermind. Casting Cut Down now on an empty stack is a waste — every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore ILLEGAL, and leaf 15 shows me spending it and then facing a 4/4 deathtouch Restless Reef with no answer. A second Enduring Curiosity taps four mana and strands Cut Down for a body that can't affect this combat. My own Drowner's shuffle ability costs me my own Floodpits Drowner (leaf 28 even strips my Enduring Curiosity and leaves me at zero mana) to remove a creature that is already tapped and cannot block. Every {3}{U} leaf hands a hellbent opponent a card while I have lethal on the stack — leaf 36 shows that gifted card being the Go for the Throat that kills my Enduring Curiosity. Lowest scores there.
response.plan: Pass and let combat damage resolve — the attack is lethal: they are at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are tapped, and two summoning-sick 1/1 ground tokens cannot stop 13 power including two unblockable fliers. Keep Cut Down and 6 mana up purely as insurance: if they flash a creature in to block, kill it on the stack or after it enters, but only if it is a legal target — total power and toughness 5 or less. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability — it eats my own creatures. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: Attackers are already declared and the swing is lethal: they are at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are TAPPED, and only two summoning-sick 1/1 Vampire Tokens can block — no flying, no reach — against Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind in the air plus Enduring Curiosity 4/3 and two Preachers 2/4 on the ground. The right play is to pass and let damage resolve while holding Cut Down and 6 mana as insurance against a flashed blocker; the do-nothing branches (4, 9, 10) score 88-92. Casting Cut Down now on an empty stack throws away my only interaction — every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, so it can only hit a tapped 2/1 or a 1/1 token that cannot block a flier anyway. A second Enduring Curiosity taps four mana and strands Cut Down for a body irrelevant to this combat. My own Drowner's shuffle ability costs me my own Floodpits Drowner (leaves 44 and 46 leave me at zero mana with Cut Down stranded) to remove a creature that is already tapped and cannot block. Every {3}{U} leaf gifts a hellbent opponent a card while I have lethal damage on the board — leaf 36 shows the gifted card being Anoint with Affliction. Lowest scores there. Pass and win.
response.plan: Pass and let combat damage resolve — the attack is lethal: they are at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are tapped, and two summoning-sick 1/1 ground tokens cannot stop 13 power including two unblockable fliers. Keep Cut Down and 6 mana up purely as insurance: if they flash a creature in to block, kill it on the stack or after it enters, but only if it is a legal target — total power and toughness 5 or less. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability — it eats my own creatures. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: Attackers are declared and the swing is lethal: they're at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are TAPPED, and only two summoning-sick 1/1 Vampire Tokens can block — no flying, no reach — against Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind in the air plus Enduring Curiosity 4/3 and two 2/4 Preachers on the ground. The play is to pass and let damage resolve while holding Cut Down and 6 mana as insurance against a flashed blocker; the do-nothing branches (0, 5, 6) score 90-92. Casting Cut Down proactively burns my only interaction — every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, so it can only hit a tapped 2/1 or a 1/1 token that cannot block a flier, and leaf 20 shows me then facing a 4/4 deathtouch Restless Reef empty-handed. A second Enduring Curiosity taps four mana for a body that does nothing this combat (leaves 21-23, ~66). My own Drowner's shuffle ability is self-harm: leaves 36, 38, 41, 43, 46 and 48 show me at ZERO mana having eaten my own Floodpits Drowner and stranded Cut Down. Every {3}{U} leaf gifts a hellbent opponent a card while I have lethal on the board — several show that card being Anoint with Affliction or an animated Reef. Lowest scores there. Pass and take the win.
response.plan: Pass and let combat damage resolve — the attack is lethal: they are at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are tapped, and two summoning-sick 1/1 ground tokens cannot stop 13 power including two unblockable fliers. Keep Cut Down and 6 mana up purely as insurance: if they flash a creature in to block, kill it on the stack or after it enters, but only if it is a legal target — total power and toughness 5 or less. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability — it eats my own creatures. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.

response.why: Blockers are declared and the swing is still lethal: they're at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are TAPPED, and only two summoning-sick 1/1 Vampire Tokens could block — no flying, no reach — against Deep-Cavern Bat and Faerie Mastermind in the air plus Enduring Curiosity 4/3 and two 2/4 Preachers on the ground. Nothing I can cast now adds damage; every option only risks the win. So pass and let damage resolve while keeping Cut Down and 6 mana as insurance against a flashed blocker — the do-nothing branches (0, 5, 10) score 90-92. Casting Cut Down proactively spends my only interaction on nothing: every Preacher is 2/4 for a total of 6 and therefore an ILLEGAL target, leaving only a tapped 2/1 or a 1/1 token, and leaf 20 shows me then staring at a 4/4 deathtouch Restless Reef with an empty grip. A second Enduring Curiosity taps four mana for a body irrelevant to this combat. My own Drowner's shuffle ability is self-harm — leaves 45, 47, 50, 52, 55 and 57 leave me at ZERO mana having eaten my own Floodpits Drowner and stranded Cut Down. Every {3}{U} leaf gifts a hellbent opponent a card while lethal damage is already on the board, several of them fueling a Sheoldred or an animated Reef. Lowest scores there. Pass and take the win.
response.plan: Pass and let combat damage resolve — the attack is lethal: they are at 5, all three of their Preachers and their Floodpits Drowner are tapped, and two summoning-sick 1/1 ground tokens cannot stop 13 power including two unblockable fliers. Keep Cut Down and 6 mana up purely as insurance: if they flash a creature in, kill it only if it is a legal target — total power and toughness 5 or less. Never target a 2/4 Preacher (total 6, illegal), Sheoldred (illegal), an Enduring Curiosity (it returns itself), or my own Bat, which keeps their Kaito exiled. Never activate my own Drowner's shuffle ability — it eats my own creatures. NEVER activate Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}.
